description: This file contains unit tests for the PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector class, which is part of the Orleans placement filtering system. The tests verify creation, filtering behavior, and metadata matching logic within the placement filter strategy.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirectorTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector class, focusing on creation, filtering, and metadata matching logic.

methods.name: CanBeCreated
methods.description: Tests that an instance of PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector can be successfully created.

methods.name: CanBeCalled
methods.description: Verifies that the Filter method of the director can be called and returns a non-empty result.

methods.name: FiltersToAllWhenNoEntry
methods.description: Checks that when no metadata entry exists, the filter returns all available silos.

methods.name: FiltersOnSingleMetadata
methods.description: Tests filtering behavior based on a single metadata key with various minimum candidate counts and expected results.

methods.name: FiltersOnMultipleMetadata
methods.description: Tests filtering behavior when multiple metadata keys are used, verifying correct filtering based on multiple criteria.
